Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want to take it. I don't want to be a slave to these pills 💔."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you need to take your medication. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 📊."

JACK:
"I don't need it. I'm fine. I just want to be free 🌟."

Dr. Smith's expression turns stern, but Jack's words strike a chord within him, and he feels a pang of uncertainty 🤔.

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, Jack. I'll take it myself. I'll prove to you that it's safe 💊."

Dr. Smith picks up the glass and downs the medication in one swift motion 💥. He waits for a moment, expecting nothing to happen, but instead, he feels a sudden jolt of confusion and disorientation 🌪️.

As he opens his eyes, he finds himself alone in the room, with no sign of Jack or the medication glass 🤯. He looks around, disoriented, and that's when he sees it: a figure standing in the corner of the room, watching him 👀.

The figure is Jack, or at least, it's supposed to be Jack. But as Dr. Smith looks closer, he realizes that it's not really Jack at all - it's just a figment of his own imagination, a manifestation of his own schizophrenia 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) Oh no... I'm the one who's been delusional all along 🤦‍♂️.

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror, and the room begins to spin around him 🌪️. The screen fades to black as Dr. Smith's screams echo through the asylum 🎥.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
